generationInstructionsSummary.common: Ordinary top-down handheld tablet factory inspection photo. Green textured anti-static ESD mat, black SOIC-8 packages, four silver pins on each side, pin-one dot, all pins in frame. 1536x1024, no border or watermark. No PCB, labels, hands or decorative objects. Natural sensor noise and soft shadows, not a pristine product render.
generationInstructionsSummary.single: Exactly one chip occupying about30percent image width, about18degrees clockwise; gray laser text three rows SV358 / A26 / 0147, neutral fluorescent light.
generationInstructionsSummary.pair: Exactly two separated chips, different tilts about+12 and-25degrees; left SV358/A26/0147, right SV385/A26/0147, slightly uneven fluorescent lighting.
generationInstructionsSummary.dim-three: Exactly three separated chips upper-left, upper-right, lower-center, rotations about-20,+15,+35degrees; all SV358/A26/0147; dim uneven light, broad shadow over lower chip, mild glare/noise, at least two chips readable at native resolution.
